## I311 - ST-290 boss attack telegraph pass (cgs-dev-story, E29 1/3, RENDER-LAYER ONLY 0 KB)

**Summary.** Boss attacks (Monolith ring 2.0s / aimed 2.2s / radial 4.0s; Splicer aimed 2.6s) all fired instantly with no anticipation phase - the sweep-grounded gap (Inner Chaos aipti2jj6ek anticipation/hit/recovery, Universal Player Combat color-coded telegraph markers, Helldivers 2 telegraphing FSHlyBfqc4c). Added a pure render-layer telegraph that reads the public attack timers (`world.boss.ringTimer` / `bossFireTimer` / `bossBurstTimer` - no new state, no sim change) and warns the player before each attack lands.

**Story goal.** Every boss attack gets a visible, readable, fx-gated warning in its final window so "sudden death" becomes "readable threat": (1) RING - expanding floor ring at the boss base growing to the blast radius; (2) AIMED - the boss core seam leans red and brightens toward the player; (3) RADIAL BURST - core pulse + ring pre-flash. All three are data-driven in `CONFIG.boss.telegraph` and pooled/reused (no per-frame allocation).

**Acceptance tests (all met).**
- Ring telegraph: 0.6s window; scale 3.4 + 5.6*teleUrgency(p,1.6) -> measured 5.2473 at p=0.30 and 8.2722 at p=0.05 (near max); opacity 0.35 * min(1, 3p) -> 0.35 peak. Floor ring at teleHeight 0.35.
- Aimed telegraph: 0.5s window; corePulse = p^2 * 0.9 -> coreIntensity 1.2270 (baseline) to 1.5510 at p=0.20 probe point; red-lean 0.6 confirmed by hex shift 9a6bff -> b665e6 (R 154->182 up, B 255->230 down = red lean).
- Burst telegraph: 0.8s window; coreBoost 1.4 -> coreIntensity 2.1020 at p=0.30; ring pre-flash scale 10 / opacity 0.1375.
- Gating: fx-off tier -> zero telegraph leak (F5: ringT 0.233 in window, all hidden). fx-low -> telegraph RETAINED (F6a direct + F6b real-loop: informational, not decorative - stinger precedent keeps telegraph, gates wobble). No boss -> all hidden.
- No sim impact: by layer only - no sim/scoring/replay data touched; demo pin structurally safe and re-verified exactly.

**Changed files.**
- `src/core/bossTelegraph.js` (NEW, ~40 LOC) - pure math: teleProgress / teleUrgency helpers (DOM-free, unit-testable).
- `src/core/config.js` - `CONFIG.boss.telegraph` block: ring{window 0.6, maxRadius 9.0, opacity 0.35}, aimed{window 0.5, coreBoost 0.9, redLean 0.6}, burst{window 0.8, coreBoost 1.4, ringRadius 10.0, opacity 0.22}. Threat red = `CONFIG.fx.enemyBullet.emissive` (0xff4a2a).
- `src/render/bossMesh.js` - `sync(boss, t, ringP, aimP, burstP)` telegraph pass: ring mesh (pooled torus geometry), core seam red-lean + intensity, burst pre-flash; `telestate()` readback for verification.
- `src/main.js` - `teleOn` fx-gate (tier-aware: off -> 0, low/med/high -> live timers); passes timer-derived progress into bossMesh.sync each frame.
- `tests/bossTelegraph.test.js` (NEW) - 6 cases: windows, urgency curve monotonicity, boundary clamps, no-leak at window edges.

**Verification evidence.**

## I312 - ST-291 engine presentation audit + warm->cool trail ramp (cgs-dev-story, E29 2/3, RENDER-LAYER 0 KB)

**Summary.** The queued ship engine/thrust trail already exists (I213 trail 14 puffs/s + ST-256 layered flame + ST-237 nozzle), so ST-291 was a probe-first audit (designated CUTTABLE). AUDIT: 3 of 4 sweep criteria PASS, 1 PARTIAL - the "bright->dim tail / palette.engine warm->cool" was implemented as a per-particle RANDOM palette pick (particles.js burst() `tmp.set(pal[(Math.random()*pal.length)|0])`), not a warm-core->cool-tail age gradient, so the trail read as a warm/cool sparkle mix rather than a smooth gradient.

**Story goal.** Make the engine trail read as a hot (warm) core fading to a cool tail along the puff lifetime - data-driven, render-layer only, 0 KB, no sim/scoring/replay change.

**Acceptance tests (all met).**
- Thrust-reactive rate: minThrust 0.12 gate + rate 14 puffs/s (deterministic accumulator) - PASS (no change).
- World-space lag: puffs spawn at ship.pos - forward*offset(1.15) in WORLD coords, ship moves on, drag exp(-3dt) - PASS (no change).
- ST-256 core/plume layering: hot white core (0xffffff op0.95 r0.10 len0.70) inside warm orange plume (0xff9a3d op0.65 r0.28 len1.25) + additive glow sprite (0xffb347 op0.40 size1.1) at nozzle root, all data-driven via CONFIG.ship.flame - PASS (no change).
- bright->dim tail: PARTIAL -> FIXED. particles.burst/sync now honor `o.ramp`: per-particle color lerps pal[0] (warm 0xffa860) -> pal[last] (cool 0x9fd8ff) by normalized age (shared per-particle brightness jitter), then the existing bright->dim fade (color * (1-age/life)). Gated by new CONFIG.fx.engineTrail.ramp (true).

**Changed files.**
- `src/render/particles.js` - added `base2` (Float32Array POOL*3) + `rampFlag` (Uint8Array POOL); burst() sets base=pal[0]/base2=pal[last] when o.ramp (else the ST-086 random pick, flag 0); sync() lerps base->base2 by age/life when rampFlag (else base*f). No per-frame allocs; non-ramp path behavior unchanged.
- `src/core/config.js` - `CONFIG.fx.engineTrail.ramp: true` (data-driven toggle, comment cites ST-291).
- `src/main.js` - engine-trail burst passes `ramp: CONFIG.fx.engineTrail.ramp`.
- BOM hygiene: an edit-tool artifact dropped one U+FEFF BOM from the leading line of config.js (4->3) and main.js (3->2) during the I312 edits; restored to the committed prefix so the committed diff carries only the intended changes.

**Verification evidence.**
- T1 A/B (deterministic, rAF frozen, manual sync): ramp 96 puffs @t0.167/life1.0 -> R<B 0/96, meanR 0.6238 > meanB 0.1882, corr(warmth,brightness) +0.842; control (no ramp) -> R<B 28/96, corr -0.546. Confirms the age gradient vs the old random mix.
- T2 live thrust (PLAYING, fx high, real loop): corr(warmth,brightness) +0.974, corr(warmth,distance-from-ship) -0.885 (older/farther puffs cooler = correct world-space gradient). Screenshot .evidence/I312/trail_live.png.

## I315 - ST-293 arena floor readability micro-pass (cgs-dev-story, E30 1/3)
- Summary: Audit-first. Pre-registered decision rule: measure the on-screen floor band luma (PLAYING + MENU fx-off) and take the TUNE branch only if the hub->mid-arena drop exceeded 15% of the hub->rim total (i.e. no distinct rest band read). MEASURED baseline: the single-pow radial grid (falloffPow 1.6) produced a SMOOTH monotone fade in PLAYING - lineP90 across 10 radial bands b1..b9 = 50.7/46.3/41.9/38.7/34.8/31.6/28.5/22.9/18.8 (no plateau; hub->mid drop 31.5% of the hub->rim total) -> rule FAILED -> TUNE branch. Honest constraint (documented in note): the strict <=15% hub->mid target is mathematically UNREACHABLE under the frozen FLOOR-50 invariant (hub gridBright luma 55.75 > 50 ceiling, rest band must stay < 50 -> hub->rest drop alone >= (55.75-50)/30.48 = 18.9%); delivered instead a distinct MID-ARENA REST BAND + steeper rim depth cut (a real, visible readability win). Implementation = a pure 2-segment curve restFalloff(t,restT,restHold,restPowA,restPowB) in floorGrid.js + restGridColorAt, driven by 4 new CONFIG.arena.grid tunables (restT 0.5 / restHold 0.76 / restPowA 0.05 / restPowB 2.0); legacy falloff/gridColorAt retained (still unit-tested). arenaFloor.js ring-stops + spoke-stops now call restGridColorAt. New rounded ring lumas 48.47/48.47/39.90/29.41/25.27 (all < 50, monotone). 9 new unit tests (endpoints/clamp, monotone, continuity@restT, rest-band flatness spread < 0.06, rim step < restHold*0.5, R>=G>=B, ring lumas < 50 + edge=dim/hub=bright, spoke ramp monotone, params data-driven + 304 segs unchanged).

## I320 - ST-297 adaptive-toast anchor fix (cgs-dev-story, E31 2/3, BY LAYER, +11 B)

**Goal.** Fix R3 finding #1 from the I319 ST-296 battery: #adaptive-toast overlapped #tutorial-hint (1380 px^2 at 720p). Single-line render/DOM change; no sim/scoring/replay touch (BY LAYER - the demo pin is structurally safe).

**Fix.** src/main.js:283 - toastEl cssText `bottom:64px` -> `bottom:calc(9% + 40px)`. The hint bar (#tutorial-hint) is pinned at bottom:9% (~20px tall, 15px font); anchoring the toast to the same 9% reference keeps the clearance constant at every viewport height (40px anchor - 20px hint = 20px gap at 720p, 800px, 480p alike). Toast stays centered (left:50%, translateX(-50%)), z60, same styling; all 11 toast() call sites share the element, so every callout (FX / MUSIC / RECORDING / PAUSED / INBOUND / WEAPON LEVEL / RUN SAVED) moves with it.

## I321 - ST-299 wave banner hidden on GAME_OVER (cgs-dev-story, E31 3/3, BY LAYER, +121 B)

**Goal.** Fix R3 finding #2 from the I319 ST-296 battery: the wave banner ("WAVE n" / "CLEARED" / boss bar) remained visible on the GAME OVER screen, overlapping the GAME OVER title (6804 px^2 at 720p). Render/DOM-only change; no sim/scoring/replay touch (BY LAYER - the demo pin is structurally safe).

**Fix.** src/render/waveBanner.js + src/main.js:897. sync() now takes the game state as a 4th argument and force-hides the banner (clears anim + text, opacity 0) via a new resetHidden() helper when state === STATE.GAME_OVER; the same helper is reused on the natural anim-expiry path (behavior there unchanged). main.js passes world.game.state. Because sync() runs on every syncVisuals (live frame AND probe advance()), the banner is guaranteed hidden by the death-frame render - even when the banner anim is mid-envelope at the instant of death. That mid-envelope hold is exactly the I319 failure state: with rAF frozen, each advance() advances the banner t by only one STEP, so an armed banner stayed at opacity 1 indefinitely.

(2) Flow = peaks and troughs with respite; perceived stress = threat count x proximity, per player, director targets low-stress players; post-panic the director refrains from spawning AND swaps item spawns based on player performance (WbHMxo11HcU [2:58][5:28][6:03][8:39]).
